question: Using only the data from the ‘results’ table, find the three years in which the sum of the highest total points earned by any driver and the highest total points earned by any constructor in that year (both calculated by summing up points from the ‘results’ table) is smallest, and list those three years in order of ascending total.
sql:
-- Get the three years with the smallest combined total
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        res.driver_id,
        SUM(res.points) as driver_total_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id
),
constructor_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        res.constructor_id,
        SUM(res.points) as constructor_total_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id
),
max_driver AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(driver_total_points) as max_driver_pts
    FROM driver_points
    GROUP BY year
),
max_constructor AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(constructor_total_points) as max_constructor_pts
    FROM constructor_points
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
    md.year,
    md.max_driver_pts,
    mc.max_constructor_pts,
    md.max_driver_pts + mc.max_constructor_pts as combined_total
FROM max_driver md
JOIN max_constructor mc ON md.year = mc.year
ORDER BY combined_total ASC
LIMIT 3
